details: Bitcoin surged past $65,000 to a two-week high after reports indicated the US and Iran reached a peace agreement to end hostilities and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. This geopolitical de-escalation boosted overall risk appetite, leading to a rebound in crypto markets and a drop in oil prices.
title: Bitcoin Rallies Above $65K on US-Iran Peace Deal

details: The Federal Reserve is widely anticipated to keep interest rates unchanged at its June 16-17 meeting, marking no rate changes since December 2025. However, markets are closely watching for any hawkish signals from the new Chair, Kevin Warsh, which could potentially impact crypto valuations by tightening liquidity conditions.
title: Federal Reserve Expected to Hold Rates Steady, Hawkish Tone Possible

details: Michael Saylor's Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy) has expanded its Bitcoin treasury by purchasing an additional 1,587 BTC for approximately $100 million. This acquisition, made between June 8 and June 14 at an average price of $63,024 per Bitcoin, brings the company's total holdings to 846,842 BTC, reinforcing its long-term accumulation strategy.
title: MicroStrategy Adds 1,587 Bitcoin for $100 Million

details: In positive regulatory developments, the CFTC has granted "No-Action Relief" allowing designated contract markets to convert digital commodity perpetual-style futures into true perpetual contracts, enhancing market liquidity and innovation. Simultaneously, the SEC approved the T. Rowe Price Active Crypto ETF for listing on NYSE Arca, which will invest in a basket of 5 to 15 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin and Ethereum, signaling expanding institutional access and regulatory acceptance for diversified crypto products.
title: US Regulators Advance Crypto: CFTC on Futures, SEC on Active ETFs
